description: This file implements a memory caching class for the ADOdb database abstraction library, specifically providing Memcache/Memcached integration for caching query results.

classes.name: ADODB_Cache_MemCache
classes.description: A class providing cache operations for Memcache and Memcached, including connection management, read/write cache, and flush operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with configuration parameters from the database connection object.

methods.name: isLibMemcached
methods.description: Checks if the current library used is Memcached.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a lazy connection to the Memcache/Memcached server(s).

methods.name: writeCache
methods.description: Stores data into the cache with a specific key and timeout.

methods.name: readCache
methods.description: Reads cached data by key, handling unserialization and timeout logic.

methods.name: flushAll
methods.description: Flushes all cached data on the server.

methods.name: flushCache
methods.description: Deletes a specific cache entry by key.
